18:07 Local Time, 16:07 GMT, 21:37 IST: A convincing win for the Proteas in the end as they seal the series with a match to spare! Having posted a daunting 365 after being sent in to bat, South Africa faced early heat as Australia started with a bang, Mitchell Marsh and Travis Head taking on the seamers and clearing the ropes with ease. But full credit to the Proteas' slow bowlers, who completely turned the tide. South Africa sent down 30 overs of spin, with Aiden Markram bowling his full allotment of 10 overs to starve the Aussies of momentum. Xavier Bartlett delayed the inevitable with a valiant half-century late in the innings, but lacked support at the other end as the chase faded.
